findings.quote: WHEREAS, in connection with the Purpose, either Party ("Disclosing Party") may disclose, directly or indirectly, certain confidential, proprietary, or business-sensitive information to the other Party ("Receiving Party"), and the Parties desire to maintain the confidentiality and restrict the dissemination and use of such information in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth herein.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB01 Mutuality (pass 0.96, breach 0.00, unclear 0.04).

findings.quote: 1.1.3 "Confidential Information" means any and all proprietary, technical, operational, commercial, or financial information disclosed by or on behalf of Disclosing Party to Receiving Party, whether orally, visually, electronically, in writing, or in tangible form, including but not limited to source code, algorithms, architecture diagrams, product roadmaps, designs, data schemas, business plans, customer lists, pricing structures, benchmarks, and trade secrets, which is designated as confidential or proprietary at the time of disclosure or which, by its nature or the circumstances surrounding its disclosure, should reasonably be understood by a prudent commercial person to be confidential.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB02 Definition of Confidential Information (pass 0.66, breach 0.30, unclear 0.04).

findings.quote: 1.1.4 "Representatives" means the directors, officers, employees, legal advisors, accountants, financial consultants, and contracted technical personnel of a Party or its Affiliates who need access to the Confidential Information for the Purpose.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB05 Permitted disclosure to Representatives and Group (pass 0.69, breach 0.19, unclear 0.12).

findings.quote: 2.1 Receiving Party shall hold all Confidential Information of Disclosing Party in strict confidence and shall exercise at least the same degree of care to avoid unauthorised disclosure, publication, or dissemination of Disclosing Party's Confidential Information as Receiving Party applies to its own confidential and proprietary information of like importance, but in no event less than a reasonable standard of care.
findings.why: Substantive term that no playbook rule covers (Jev other_term 0.97).

findings.quote: 2.2 Receiving Party agrees to use Disclosing Party's Confidential Information solely and exclusively for the Purpose and shall not exploit, commercialise, or use such Confidential Information for any other purpose or for the benefit of any third party without Disclosing Party's prior written approval.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as unclear against PB03 Purpose limitation (pass 0.38, breach 0.09, unclear 0.53).

findings.quote: 2.3 Receiving Party shall not copy, duplicate, or reproduce Disclosing Party's Confidential Information except to the extent strictly necessary for the Purpose. All copies shall remain the property of Disclosing Party and shall contain all proprietary notices present on the original.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB08 Ownership, licences and IP (pass 0.99, breach 0.00, unclear 0.01).

findings.quote: 2.4 Receiving Party shall not decompile, disassemble, reverse engineer, or attempt to derive the composition or underlying source code of any software, binary modules, or prototypes furnished by Disclosing Party hereunder.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB20 Reverse engineering (pass 1.00, breach 0.00, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote:
3.1 Receiving Party may disclose Disclosing Party's Confidential Information only to those of its Representatives who:
3.1.1 have an absolute need to know such information in connection with the Purpose;
3.1.2 are informed of the confidential and proprietary nature of such Confidential Information; and
3.1.3 are bound by confidentiality, non-disclosure, and restricted use undertakings substantially similar to and no less restrictive than those set forth in this Agreement.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as unclear against PB05 Permitted disclosure to Representatives and Group (pass 0.43, breach 0.19, unclear 0.38).

findings.quote: 3.2 Receiving Party shall remain fully responsible and liable for any act, omission, or breach of this Agreement by any of its Representatives as if such act or omission had been committed directly by Receiving Party.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB05 Permitted disclosure to Representatives and Group (pass 0.70, breach 0.03, unclear 0.27).
Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB04 Carve-outs (pass 0.95, breach 0.05, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote: 4.2 Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, Receiving Party shall be free to use and exploit for any purpose any general ideas, concepts, know-how, methodologies, or techniques retained in the unaided memory of Receiving Party's or its Affiliates' personnel who have had authorised access to Disclosing Party's Confidential Information under this Agreement, provided that such personnel do not intentionally memorise such information for the purpose of evading the restrictions of this Agreement.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Halyard does not agree to residuals clauses; the existing confidentiality and use restrictions should apply without a memory exception.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as breaches against PB17 Residuals (pass 0.00, breach 1.00, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote:
5.1 Receiving Party may disclose Confidential Information to the extent required pursuant to a valid order of a court of competent jurisdiction or an administrative or regulatory agency, or pursuant to applicable statutory laws or regulations, provided that Receiving Party shall:
5.1.1 give prompt written notice to Disclosing Party prior to making such disclosure, to the extent legally permissible, so that Disclosing Party may seek a protective order or other appropriate remedy;
5.1.2 provide reasonable cooperation to Disclosing Party, at Disclosing Party's expense, in opposing or limiting the scope of such disclosure; and
5.1.3 disclose only that portion of the Confidential Information that is legally mandated to be disclosed.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB06 Compelled disclosure (pass 1.00, breach 0.00, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote:
6.1 Upon the written demand of Disclosing Party at any time, or upon the termination of this Agreement, Receiving Party shall promptly, and in any event within fourteen (14) calendar days:
6.1.1 return to Disclosing Party or, at Disclosing Party's election, securely destroy and expunge all documents, materials, files, magnetic media, and embodiments containing Confidential Information; and
6.1.2 provide a written certificate executed by an authorised corporate officer certifying compliance with the obligations set forth in Clause 6.1.1.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as breaches against PB07 Return and destruction (pass 0.31, breach 0.69, unclear 0.00).

findings.quote: 6.2 Notwithstanding Clause 6.1, Receiving Party may retain one (1) archival copy of Confidential Information solely for legal, compliance, or regulatory audit purposes, and shall not be required to expunge automated electronic backup media created in the ordinary course of business, provided that all such retained information remains subject to the confidentiality and non-use provisions of this Agreement until destroyed.
findings.why: Jev reads the clause as matches preferred against PB07 Return and destruction (pass 0.82, breach 0.14, unclear 0.04).

findings.quote: 7.1 All Confidential Information disclosed hereunder remains the exclusive and absolute property of Disclosing Party. Nothing in this Agreement shall be construed as granting, conferring, or implying any licence, title, interest, right, or ownership in or to any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret, or other intellectual property rights of Disclosing Party.

findings.quote: 7.2 All Confidential Information is provided by Disclosing Party on an "as is" and "with all faults" basis. Disclosing Party disclaims any express or implied warranties of any kind regarding the accuracy, completeness, non-infringement, merchantability, or fitness for a particular purpose of its Confidential Information. Disclosing Party shall have no liability whatsoever resulting from Receiving Party's use of, or reliance upon, any Confidential Information.

findings.quote: 10.1 The Parties acknowledge that any breach of this Agreement may result in immediate, irreparable harm and injury to Disclosing Party for which monetary damages alone would be inadequate. Accordingly, Disclosing Party shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief, specific performance, and other equitable remedies in any court of competent jurisdiction to enforce the provisions hereof, without the necessity of proving actual damages or posting any bond.

findings.quote: 10.2 Without prejudice to Disclosing Party's right to seek injunctive relief under Clause 10.1, the Parties agree that in the event of any unauthorised disclosure, publication, or misuse of Confidential Information by Receiving Party or any of its Representatives, Receiving Party shall pay to Disclosing Party, as pre-estimated liquidated damages and not as a penalty, the fixed sum of £50,000 (fifty thousand pounds sterling) per breach, payable within thirty (30) days of receipt of Disclosing Party's formal written demand.
